author: Animalogic
description:
Ever wonder why your cat won't stop meowing at you? 🐾

It turns out cats have figured out that humans are essentially scent-blind compared to them. To get our attention, they developed a clever communication method specifically designed to manipulate us into giving them what they need... with nearly 100% efficiency!

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
